notes.title: We've Launched a Strategy Guide to help our players understand more and get higher numbers!
notes.notes:
We've excited about all the feedbacks we're getting about the game. Players have sent us a lot o good ideas, critiques and kind words.

But the subject that is always there is about the game's difficulty. We designed the game to be difficult in order to make players to test a lot of strategies, but we know that can be frustrating.

For that reason, I've written a simple Strategy Guide with a lot of insights about the progression of the game and how you can build a good start to get higher numbers and go far!

Please take a look:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1207182973

notes.title: Give us feedback!
notes.notes:
Welcome everyone.

We're here to say that we are really open devs and love everything about making games. We'd love to see what you have to say about the game, about us, so please do!

We don't mind harsh critics or anything like that. We want to know what's happening, what are the things you're finding in the game, if it's boring, bad, good, slow, fun...

So please, use our discussion boards as you like, ask for tips, help, changes, new modes/additions. We'll be glad to work to provide better games and evolve what he have into things you'll love.
